connect.title: Connect an agent
connect.description: Give Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or any MCP client a memory. Every client uses the same server URL and signs in with your Zekra account.
connect.urlHint: Paste this into your client. You'll sign in on app.zekra.dev and choose which brains it can use.
connect.claude.name: Claude.ai & Claude Desktop
connect.claude.s2: Choose Add custom connector and paste the URL.
connect.claude.s3: Leave the OAuth client ID and secret blank.
connect.claude.s4: Click Connect, sign in on app.zekra.dev and choose your brains.
connect.chatgpt.name: ChatGPT
connect.chatgpt.s1: Open Settings → Apps & Connectors → Advanced settings and turn on Developer mode.
connect.chatgpt.s2: Choose Create connector and paste the URL.
connect.chatgpt.s4: Sign in on app.zekra.dev and approve access.
connect.claudeCode.name: Claude Code
connect.claudeCode.s2: Then run /mcp inside Claude Code to sign in.

connect.gemini.name: Gemini CLI
connect.stdio.name: Codex and other stdio clients
connect.stdio.s3: Install the MCP server for your client:
connect.stdio.token: Mint a token on a brain's Sessions page.
